theorems.name: Submission.idtp_pc_constancy_reduction
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid P)) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P) (g : Euclid P → ℝ), IsOpen V → Orthonormal ℝ τ → IsConnected (V ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P))) → AEStronglyMeasurable g (μHE[n].restrict (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P))) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P))), ∃ m : ℤ, g x = m) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → ∫⁻ x in K ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)), ‖g x‖ₑ ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞) → (∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ V → ∀ j : Fin n, ∫ x in V ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)), g x * fderiv ℝ f x (τ j) ∂μHE[n] = 0) → IsOpen {s : Euclid n | ∑ i, s i • τ i ∈ V} ∧ IsPreconnected {s : Euclid n | ∑ i, s i • τ i ∈ V} ∧ LocallyIntegrableOn (fun s : Euclid n => g (∑ i, s i • τ i)) {s : Euclid n | ∑ i, s i • τ i ∈ V} volume ∧ (∀ φ : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ {s : Euclid n | ∑ i, s i • τ i ∈ V} → ∀ i : Fin n, ∫ s, g (∑ k, s k • τ k) * fderiv ℝ φ s ((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) i) = 0) ∧ ∀ c₀ : ℝ, (∀ᵐ s ∂(volume.restrict {s : Euclid n | ∑ i, s i • τ i ∈ V}), g (∑ i, s i • τ i) = c₀) → ∃ c : ℤ, ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (V ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)))), g x = c
